gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-plein: LXGW WenKai TC writes with a casual, graceful pen, its stroke ends as wide as the middle throughout. Plein, the sans-serif, brings a reliable, clean counterpoint.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-recia: Casual pen strokes, then sharp ones. Recia's classic serif keeps hairlines sturdy beside moderate stems, so LXGW WenKai TC's single-marker looseness has something crisp to lean on in brief reading.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-rowan: LXGW WenKai TC bends every letter like thin steel rod, loose and handwritten, above Rowan's friendly text serif with thin strokes only slightly lighter than thick. It feels better for brief copy than for pages.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps where its curves meet the stems. Its identical vertical and horizontal weight sits under LXGW WenKai TC's pen-and-paper looseness, and that handwritten-versus-sans split is the draw.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-synonym: Graceful, loose, handwritten up top. Synonym below is a plain sans of constant ink with generous curve openings, and its size is the one to adjust, since it suits short stretches of reading under LXGW WenKai TC.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-outfit: Outfit is clean and approachable. Its cable-like curves finish well before they close, and under LXGW WenKai TC's casual handwriting it feels comfortable in small doses rather than across pages.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline sans-serif whose curve endings stay well apart beneath LXGW WenKai TC's handwriting. It is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-sora: LXGW WenKai TC's pen never shifts pressure or angle, giving casual, open-handed round characters above Sora's precise, geometric sans-serif. A handful of lines is where it works.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads neutral and geometric, each glyph a ribbon of constant width with counters that breathe. Its quiet geometry against LXGW WenKai TC's handwriting is the strongest quality here, good for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-bespoke-sans: Ma Shan Zheng crams its handwritten letters together like teeth in a crowded smile, holding one pen width throughout, while Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined. One brings personality; the other, generous room.
gen-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-literata: Sophisticated and bookish, Literata gives curved letters wide, unclosed mouths and a calm gradient of weight, while Ma Shan Zheng cuts every stroke to a single depth. The heading charms; the body carries brief copy better.
gen-gf-mali-fs-amulya: Amulya reads as a plain sans with generous gaps in its curves, modern and unfussy. Amulya's open build is the pair's strongest quality, and Mali's casual pen-and-paper heading is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-mali-fs-neco: Mali's letters look scribbled by hand, friendly and loose. Neco follows in a text serif, its swell from hairline to stem measured and dignified, so the casual heading meets a body that sounds authoritative.
gen-gf-mali-fs-plein: Mali writes its heading like a quick note. Mali's handwriting is the warm, casual part, while Plein, a sans with a clear channel into each round letter, does the dependable work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-mali-fs-recia: Handwritten charm meets a sharp serif. Mali's loose pen-and-paper heading sits over Recia, a text serif whose gentle modulation shows only up close, and the two feel relaxed yet quietly authoritative.
gen-gf-mali-fs-rowan: Rowan is a friendly, literary text serif whose thin strokes carry about half the weight of its thick ones. Rowan against Mali's casual handwriting is the pair's strongest quality: a loose heading over a body with comfortable contrast.
gen-gf-mali-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans draws wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with every stroke the same weight. Spline Sans keeps a longer read approachable and smooth, a plain sans sitting under Mali's hand-written heading.
gen-gf-mali-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, dependable and clean. Under Mali's handwritten heading, this sans-serif body reads steadily across a longer stretch, its curves open and its line weight never wavering.
gen-gf-mali-plus-jakarta-sans: Mali brings loose, pen-and-paper handwriting to the heading, never cramped at the c tips. Plus Jakarta Sans follows as a plain sans, monoline and precise, so a longer passage runs smooth with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-mali-sora: Mali's heading looks scrawled with a pen, inviting and casual. Sora's geometric sans-serif is the pair's strongest quality, precise where Mali is loose, with no pressure swell at the corners of its curves.
gen-gf-mali-space-grotesk: Handwritten warmth on top, geometric precision below. Mali's casual strokes lead, and Space Grotesk, a sans-serif with a ribbon of constant width, carries a longer passage with open counters and a steady feel.
gen-gf-margarine-fs-karma: Pencil-line smooth and oddly tall. Margarine draws big lowercase in unshaded strokes, and if the heading shrinks it loses its swagger, while Karma's text serif keeps a gentle brush-like swell.
gen-gf-margarine-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its lowercase sitting close to the capitals. Paquito holds the text steady beneath Margarine, whose tall lowercase and smooth, pressure-free curves do the showing off.
gen-gf-mclaren-fs-rowan: Friendly and literary, Rowan opens every curve wide and keeps its thin strokes about half as heavy as the thick ones. McLaren above it stays low and expressive, and it wears you out slowly.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-karma: Tall, narrow-stemmed and sharp-edged, MedievalSharp looks carved. Karma underneath is quieter, a serif with terminals held away from the stem, so the two feel like a proclamation followed by a trusted hand.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with capitals that sit close to its lowercase height. Paquito is better for brief copy than a long stretch, while MedievalSharp above it stays tall, bold and commanding.
gen-gf-merienda-fs-bespoke-sans: Hand-drawn warmth up top. Merienda is friendly and graceful where it counts, while Bespoke Sans handles the sharp, refined work, with curves that stop well short of the stem for brief reading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One is a classic serif with literary weight, its strokes unshaded and its joins sturdy. And across a longer stretch it slows you to a leisurely walk, curvy and unclamped, under Metamorphous.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, stretching each word out with open counters and no thick-thin shifts, like a bent paperclip. Metamorphous earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kiwi-maru: Quiet drama, then tradition. Kiwi Maru follows the heading with generous letterspace and rounded o shapes of constant wall, a classic serif whose paperclip strokes sit low beside Metamorphous's high-set midline.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-padyakke-expanded: Metamorphous brings a commanding, high-set midline and a restrained gap between fat and slim strokes, while Padyakke Expanded One answers with a constant pen width. Their difference in stroke is the pair's strongest quality.
